policy: Sanitized local regressions only; no third-party source, credentials, or runtime execution.

cases.rationale: Representative stdio executor shape with an unpinned package.
Covers the uvx executor spelling used by Python-oriented servers.
Environment-backed bearer and header references must not trigger missing-auth findings.
Loopback browser bridges are local transports and need no remote-auth finding.
A metadata target is private and also lacks visible remote authentication.
Docker socket mounts expose a broad filesystem path and host control surface.
Pinned local execution with environment-backed credentials is a clean baseline.
Credential-like placeholders must be reported without being copied into evidence.
